instruction: Start slapd with on-disk configuration directory
output: slapd -F /etc/ldap/slapd.d

instruction: Convert slapd.conf to slapd.d config format
output: slaptest -f /etc/ldap/slapd.conf -F /etc/ldap/slapd.d

instruction: View the cn=config LDAP database
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b cn=config

instruction: View the olcDatabase config for hdb
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b 'olcDatabase={1}hdb,cn=config'

instruction: Set the LDAP suffix via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcSuffix
olcSuffix: dc=example,dc=com'

instruction: Set the LDAP root DN via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcRootDN
olcRootDN: cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com'

instruction: Set the LDAP root password via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcRootPW
olcRootPW: {SSHA}hashedpassword'

instruction: Add an access control rule via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcAccess
olcAccess: to attrs=userPassword by self write by anonymous auth by * none'

instruction: Set an ACL to allow read access for all authenticated users
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcAccess
olcAccess: to * by users read by * none'

instruction: Enable TLS in OpenLDAP via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcTLSCertificateFile
olcTLSCertificateFile: /etc/ssl/certs/ldap.pem
-
add: olcTLSCertificateKeyFile
olcTLSCertificateKeyFile: /etc/ssl/private/ldap.key'

instruction: Set TLS CA certificate file in OpenLDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcTLSCACertificateFile
olcTLSCACertificateFile: /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem'

instruction: Require TLS for all LDAP connections
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcSecurity
tls=1'

instruction: Enable the memberOf overlay in OpenLDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}memberof,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcMemberOf
olcOverlay: memberOf'

instruction: Enable the ppolicy (password policy) overlay
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}ppolicy,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcPPolicyConfig
olcOverlay: ppolicy
olcPPolicyDefault: cn=default,ou=policies,dc=example,dc=com'

instruction: Set LDAP log level via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcLogLevel
olcLogLevel: stats'

instruction: Set LDAP log level to 256 (trace)
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcLogLevel
olcLogLevel: 256'

instruction: Set the LDAP database directory via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbDirectory
olcDbDirectory: /var/lib/ldap'

instruction: Set the checkpoint interval for the MDB database
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbCheckpoint
olcDbCheckpoint: 1024 15'

instruction: Enable the syncprov overlay for LDAP replication
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}syncprov,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcSyncProvConfig
olcOverlay: syncprov'

instruction: Set up a LDAP replication consumer
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcSyncrepl
olcSyncrepl: rid=001 provider=ldap://master.example.com binddn=cn=replicator,dc=example,dc=com credentials=secret searchbase=dc=example,dc=com schemachecking=on type=refreshAndPersist'

instruction: Set the LDAP referral for a suffix
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcUpdateref
olcUpdateref: ldap://backup.example.com'

instruction: Add an index to the LDAP database
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcDbIndex
olcDbIndex: uid eq,sub'

instruction: Set the LDAP read-only database
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcReadOnly
olcReadOnly: TRUE'

instruction: Set the LDAP subordinate database flag
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcSubordinate
olcSubordinate: TRUE'

instruction: Create a new LDAP database via cn=config
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={3}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcMdbConfig
olcDatabase: {3}mdb
olcSuffix: dc=other,dc=com
olcRootDN: cn=admin,dc=other,dc=com
olcDbDirectory: /var/lib/ldap/other'
